summary: Added the 'edit' command group for course authoring (metadata, sections, instructions, publish) via read-modify-write PUT /concept.
reason: Course authoring is not a spec endpoint; Dawn persists the whole course document, so authoring needs a hand-written safe read-modify-write layer with preview-by-default/--apply.
validated_outcome: Live-verified against a test course: preview never wrote; --apply wrote; sections/instructions round-tripped; course restored to empty after.
